story.title: A treble and a World Cup
story.body: In 2013 Schweinsteiger was part of Bayern’s treble-winning side. The following year he was part of Germany’s World Cup-winning team. One achievement came with Bayern, the other with his national team.

story.title: A long Bayern career
story.body: Bayern’s Hall of Fame records 500 competitive appearances and 68 goals for Schweinsteiger. Both numbers refer to his Bayern club career, rather than his appearances or goals for Germany.

story.title: Domestic success
story.body: Schweinsteiger won eight Bundesliga titles with Bayern. That domestic total belongs to his club honours; it is separate from the 2013 treble and his later international World Cup success with Germany.
